downloadIntro.zh: Windows 版已更新至 v1.59.70，Mac 版当前为 v1.59.60。请选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: Windows is now v1.59.70; the current Mac release is v1.59.60. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 指标设置按 TradingView 改版，分输入、样式、可见范围三页：可以调线型、透明度、小数位和偏移，可以设成只在某些周期显示，也可以保存为默认。
highlights.en: Indicator settings follow TradingView, with Inputs, Style and Visibility tabs: set line style, opacity, decimals and offset, show an indicator on chosen timeframes only, and save your settings as the default.

highlights.zh: 指标可以按更大的周期计算，比如在 M5 图上显示 H1 的均线，可选「等待周期收线」；还可以给指标加平滑线，包括 SMA + 布林带。
highlights.en: Indicators can be computed on a higher timeframe, such as an H1 moving average on an M5 chart, with an optional Wait for timeframe closes; they can also get a smoothing line, SMA + Bollinger Bands included.

highlights.zh: 「均线组」指标，一个指标里放多条均线；图表模板可以设为默认；标签在所有存档之间共用。
highlights.en: A Moving Average Ribbon indicator holds several moving averages in one; a chart template can be starred as the default; tags are shared across all sessions.

highlights.zh: 加了很多指标时，回放明显更流畅；新建存档默认带一年历史；跳转会清掉已平仓交易时，先弹窗确认。
highlights.en: Replay runs much more smoothly with many indicators; new sessions start with a year of history; a jump that would erase closed trades asks first.

highlights.zh: 拖动过价格轴后切换周期，K 线看不见了。
highlights.en: After dragging the price axis, switching timeframes could leave the candles out of view.
